regions.text: Oを原點とする。Oを通つて互に直交する二定直線RORおよびRORを取る。Oの右を正とし、左を負とする。またO密なの上を正とし下を負とする。

quote.translation: Let O be the origin, and take two fixed straight lines, ROR and R′OR′, that pass through O and intersect at right angles, with the right of O taken as positive and the left as negative, and above O positive and below negative.

regions.text: 座機軸の中横輪RORは現質性の傾域を表はし継軸RVORは非現實性の頷域を表はす。

quote.translation: Of the coordinate axes, the horizontal axis ROR represents the domain of actuality and the vertical axis R′OR′ the domain of non-actuality.

regions.text: 必然性Nは横軸上にあつて正の方向に位し偶然性Cは負の方向に位す。可能性Pは縦軸上にあつて正の方向にし、不可能性！は負の方向に位す。

quote.translation: Necessity N lies on the horizontal axis in the positive direction and contingency C in the negative direction; possibility P lies on the vertical axis in the positive direction and impossibility I in the negative direction.

quote.translation: The first quadrant (I) and the third quadrant (III) are the field of the relation of subalternation, the fourth quadrant (IV) the field of contrary opposition, and the second quadrant (II) the field of subcontrary opposition.
